name: get_quote
description: Get a swap quote and a short-lived quote ticket. Nothing is signed or sent.

arguments.name: tokenIn
arguments.desc: Token address or native symbol (ETH, BNB, SOL)

arguments.name: amountIn
arguments.desc: Integer amount of tokenIn in base units

arguments.name: chain
arguments.desc: solana, base, bnb, ethereum, or a numeric chain id (default base)

name: build_swap
description: Build an unsigned swap transaction for the user's own wallet to review and sign. There is no execute, sign or broadcast tool.

arguments.name: amountIn
arguments.desc: Integer amount of tokenIn in base units

arguments.name: recipient
arguments.desc: The user's wallet address (address only, never a key)

arguments.name: chain
arguments.desc: solana, base, bnb, ethereum, or a numeric chain id (default base)
